nodes.title: Trading
nodes.summary: XAUUSD gold. Near-term skill that pays bills and subscriptions. One session.
nodes.note:
Near-term skill that pays bills and subscriptions. Market is XAUUSD gold. See Ndegwa, Daily rhythm, and Glossary.

The method is the Origin. Timeframes are the Trigger. Size is the Lot ladder. News and "no trade" live under Stand aside. Named strategy notes live under Strategy notes.

Start at 0.01 lot (~$10.8 margin). Stop under $4 always. Fixed $20 take-profit until the account grows from $15 to $500, then dynamic. Max 2 trades a session. Two losses and he is out.

The success metric is 10 Clean trades, not 10 wins.

nodes.title: Trigger
nodes.note: 15m origin controls the zone. 5m is the trending entry zone. A held 1m origin is the only trigger. No clear 1m held origin means no trade. See Origin.

nodes.title: Visuals
nodes.summary: Embed URLs for every static visual in docs/.
nodes.note:
Every visual is a file under docs/. Serve that folder over https. Append query params to override docs/data/state.json. Use ?src= for another JSON file on the same host.

| Visual | File | Suggested height | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| Life graph | graph.html | ~500px | focus (hub id), embed=1 |
| Progress ring | ring.html | ~300px | balance, goal, start, rungs |
| Lot ladder | ladder.html | ~300px | balance, rungs as balance:lot |
| Session header | header.html | ~180px | state = ready / standaside / done |
| Session timeline | timeline.html | ~160px | state, trades, losses, now=HH:MM |
| Clean trades | heat.html | ~160px | clean, target, seq (e.g. 1101) |

Shared data: docs/data/state.json (schema v1). Regenerate the graph from notes with node scripts/build-graph.mjs. Notion property names for the bot live in docs/data/notion-config.json as (confirm) until updated.

See Trading, Daily rhythm, and Glossary for what the numbers mean. Bots must not invent values; see How to work with me.
